ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Sandeep Gupta significantly increased his individual stake in Asian Hotels (West) Limited, acquiring 951,141 shares (8.16%) as a gift from Vinita Gupta, raising his total holding to 16.32%. This inter-se transfer between immediate relatives, exempt under SEBI regulations, represents an internal reallocation of shares within the promoter group, having no direct financial impact on the company or signaling a change in overall corporate control. No red flags are identified, as the transaction appears compliant with regulatory provisions for such family transfers.
